ja.title: 食事とともに400 mgか2時間空けて600 mgか。タレトレクチニブの公開PK比較
ja.summary: ROS1阻害薬タレトレクチニブの承認用法（2時間空けて600 mg）と、FDAが市販後の試験で求めた「食事とともに400 mg」を、FDA審査報告のPopPKモデルと肝毒性の曝露反応モデルで、食事の守り方のぶれを含めて仮想患者4,096人で比べる。
ja.seo_title: タレトレクチニブの食事条件と用量を比べる
ja.seo_description: タレトレクチニブ600 mgの承認用法と食事時400 mgを、FDA公開PopPK・肝毒性モデルで仮想比較。食事遵守のばらつきと外挿の限界も調べる。

en.title: 400 mg with a meal or 600 mg two hours apart: comparing taletrectinib dosing instructions with FDA's public models
en.summary: FDA taletrectinib models compare food and dose conditions, distinguishing lower exposure, relative hepatic-toxicity hazards, and unverified regular-meal effects.
en.seo_description: FDA models compare taletrectinib food and dose conditions, separating long-run exposure and relative liver-toxicity hazards from unproven clinical benefit.

english.title: 400 mg with a meal or 600 mg two hours apart: comparing taletrectinib dosing instructions with FDA's public models
english.summary: A Japanese technical note that uses the PopPK and hepatotoxicity exposure-response models in FDA's review of taletrectinib to compare the approved 600 mg instruction (two hours before or after a meal) with 400 mg taken with meals, including imperfect meal adherence, in 4,096 virtual patients.
